description: This Java source file defines the class 'OneForOneBlockFetcher', which manages fetching shuffle blocks or chunks over a network in Apache Spark. It handles creating fetch messages, processing responses, and invoking callbacks for success or failure.

classes.name: OneForOneBlockFetcher
classes.description: A class that fetches shuffle blocks or chunks over the network, handling message creation, response processing, and invoking callbacks.

classes.name: BlocksInfo
classes.description: A helper class to store block IDs and their associated reduce or chunk IDs within a map.

classes.name: ChunkCallback
classes.description: A callback class invoked upon receipt of each chunk, passing success or failure to the listener.

classes.name: DownloadCallback
classes.description: Handles streaming data into temporary files during block fetches, and manages success or failure callbacks.

methods.name: areShuffleBlocksOrChunks
methods.description: Determines if all block IDs are either shuffle blocks or shuffle chunks.

methods.name: isAnyBlockNotStartWithShuffleBlockPrefix
methods.description: Checks if any block ID does not start with the 'shuffle_' prefix.

methods.name: isAllBlocksStartWithShuffleChunkPrefix
methods.description: Checks if all block IDs start with the 'shuffleChunk_' prefix.

methods.name: createFetchShuffleBlocksOrChunksMsg
methods.description: Creates a fetch message for either shuffle blocks or chunks based on block ID prefix.

methods.name: createFetchShuffleBlocksMsg
methods.description: Creates a FetchShuffleBlocks message for a set of block IDs.

methods.name: createFetchShuffleChunksMsg
methods.description: Creates a FetchShuffleBlockChunks message for a set of block IDs.

methods.name: getSecondaryIds
methods.description: Extracts secondary IDs (reduce or chunk IDs) from BlocksInfo map.

methods.name: splitBlockId
methods.description: Splits a block ID string into its components based on underscore delimiters.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates the fetch process, sending RPC and handling responses to fetch blocks or chunks.

methods.name: failRemainingBlocks
methods.description: Invokes failure callback for all remaining block IDs.
